_doc: Per-network fork config, read by script/utils/fork-test.sh (rpc env var, block) and test/PauserFork.t.sol (registry). Select one with `make fork-test NETWORK=<key>`. `rpcEnv` names the environment variable holding the archive RPC URL (CI secret or contracts/confidential-wrapper-pauser/.env). `block` null (the default) forks latest - 50; a positive integer pins a run, and FORK_BLOCK overrides it. Registries mirror config/networks.json.
